title: n plus sum of digits of n
notes: The iteration n ↦ n+s(n) is the classical Kaprekar generator whose non-image points are self-numbers (A003052). The balanced-ternary map n ↦ n+W(n) is the same architectural class with W = A005812. Cited as prior art for docs/problems/balanced_ternary_weight_drift.md.
